notes.title: New Platform: Apple iOS iPhone/iPad
notes.notes:
You can now play the game on iPhones/iPads:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dragon-fury-fighting/id1624333059

Use Touchscreen (1 player)
or BlueTooth Gamepads (1-2 players supported)

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: New Platform: Android Google Play
notes.notes:
You can now play the game on Android Phones:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.esenthel.df

Use Touchscreen (1 player)
or BlueTooth Gamepads (1-2 players supported)

Mods (custom characters) are working too!

Enjoy! :)

Thanks!
